sentences.text: The patient is a 57-year-old female, and your records contain 12 source reports dated between 1995-08-13 and 2021-11-07.
Your records list Diabetes, Hypertriglyceridemia, Metabolic syndrome X, and Hypertension.

Your records also list Diabetic retinopathy associated with type II diabetes mellitus, Nonproliferative diabetic retinopathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus, and Neuropathy due to type 2 diabetes mellitus.
In addition, your records list Chronic kidney disease stage 1 and Diabetic renal disease.

For creatinine (a kidney test), your latest result was 2.3 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of 0.6-1.2 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 1.7 mg/dL to 2.2 mg/dL and then 2.3 mg/dL.

For eGFR (how well the kidneys filter blood), your latest result was 32.8 mL/min/1.73m2 on 2021-11-07, which is below the usual range of above 60 mL/min/1.73m2, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went down from 43.5 mL/min/1.73m2 to 34.5 mL/min/1.73m2 and then 32.8 mL/min/1.73m2.

For LDL cholesterol (often called 'bad' cholesterol), your latest result was 140.7 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of below 100 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 120 mg/dL to 122.1 mg/dL and then 140.7 mg/dL.

For total cholesterol, your latest result was 227.6 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of below 200 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 208.8 mg/dL to 209 mg/dL and then 227.6 mg/dL.

For blood sugar (glucose), your latest result was 112.3 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of 70-99 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went up from 104.8 mg/dL to 107.4 mg/dL and then 112.3 mg/dL.

For triglycerides (a type of blood fat), your latest result was 157.5 mg/dL on 2021-11-07, which is above the usual range of below 150 mg/dL, and between 2021-09-05 and 2021-11-07 it went from 171.1 mg/dL to 178.9 mg/dL and then 157.5 mg/dL.
The rest of your test results did not raise an alert.
Your blood-pressure screening is normal, with a latest reading of 132/86 on 2021-11-07 which is below 140/90.
Your anaemia screening is also normal, with haemoglobin at 13.6 g/dL which is at or above 12 g/dL.

Your ongoing medications include lisinopril 10 MG Oral Tablet, Hydrochlorothiazide 25 MG Oral Tablet, and insulin human isophane 70 UNT/ML / Regular Insulin Human 30 UNT/ML Injectable Suspension [Humulin].
You also previously took Amoxicillin 250 MG / Clavulanate 125 MG Oral Tablet from 2019-10-13 to 2019-11-02.
No allergies are recorded in the supplied records.

sections.title: Points to discuss with your doctor

sentences.text: You could discuss your recent creatinine and eGFR trends with your doctor.
You can also talk about your blood sugar, LDL cholesterol, total cholesterol, and triglyceride levels.
